title: Debug: APB Slave
constraints: Intended register map (word addresses, `paddr[3:2]` selects): 0x0 CTRL (reset 0), 0x4 CONFIG (reset `32'h0000_00FF`), 0x8 DATA (reset 0), 0xC ID (read-only, always `32'hC0DE_0001`).
A write takes effect on the rising edge of the ACCESS phase (`psel && penable && pwrite`). Writes to ID are ignored.
`prdata` = the selected register whenever `psel && !pwrite`, else 0 (combinational). `pready = 1` (no wait states). `presetn` is active low and synchronous.
hints: Write a pattern to each of the 4 addresses, then read them all back. Do the addresses alias?
Write to the ID register, then read it.
